note: Mechanical repairs applied to compiler output so a package can ship before upstream fixes the emitter. A repair may only correct TEXT. It may never change absence, reference identity, equality, ordering, exception shape, or task settlement -- those are the contract in AGENTS.md, and a semantic repair is a lie that our own tests would then certify. Every repair declares the upstream defect it stands in for, and `npm run sdk:check` fails when a repair stops matching anything, so a repair cannot outlive the bug it answers. Two kinds exist. A declared `insert-forward-declaration` entry below names a symbol the emitter omits. The duplicate-structural-struct aliasing in scripts/emissionRepairs.mjs needs no entry because it is derived entirely from the emitted tree: it finds an anonymous structural struct defined in more than one package namespace with BYTE-IDENTICAL bodies, keeps the flight::types definition, and turns every other copy into a type alias to it. It reports what it aliased in manifest.duplicateStructuralStructAliases, and it is self-expiring -- when the emitter stops duplicating these, it finds nothing and rewrites nothing.
